p: LaFleur praised his poise and work ethic after the Cowboys game, but he never explicitly named the starter or how the offense will change for him.
all he's done is be the guy that we expected.
Minshew will start at QB this week against Seattle.
He is the locked-in starter after a high-scoring relief outing, which makes him a streaming option and lifts the passing-game players around him.
We'll go with Garner as our starter.
Minshew replaced Brissett during the game, but LaFleur did not commit to him as the Week 9 starter.
He sparked the offense in the second half and is a live QB1 candidate, but LaFleur wouldn't confirm a starter.
